findings.label: Box-drawing chars in component comments
findings.detail: AutoApplyPreviewBar.tsx uses the box-drawing character U+2500 in two JSX divider comments. It is non-ASCII and contradicts the commit's 'clean ASCII' claim, but scripts/ascii-copy-sweep.mjs (pnpm copy:check) only sweeps em/en dashes, curly quotes, ellipsis, and accented Latin letters, so no gate fails. Optional: replace with ASCII dashes for consistency with the house ASCII rule.
